core_obligations: Reduce to X affine with U a finite union of affines
Build the generization localization B' over the preimage of Z via the pro-etale lemma
Recognize the resulting family as an fpqc covering

proof_roadmap.step: Reduce to X affine with U a finite union of affines

difficulty_reason: Reduce to X affine by an etale cover; U is a finite union of affines; choose an affine W -> Y surjective over f^{-1}Z with V(J) the preimage of Z; the pro-etale localization lemma produces B -> B' whose points are exactly the generizations of V(J), and the composite Spec(B') -> X is flat because f is flat at all points of f^{-1}Z; then {Spec(B') -> X, U_1 -> X, ..., U_n -> X} is an fpqc covering by the recognition lemma.

compared.note: The pro-etale localization trick is the non-routine step; consumed by lemma-equivalence-on-affine and lemma-reflects-isomorphisms (same wave).
